cases.scenario: An explicitly named agent-required scenario is applicable to one frozen full SHA.
must: run only the named authorized live proof under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03
record exact actor and candidate evidence under §A-SESSION-01
report methodology friction to the caller as one ordinary Methodology-Friction message under §A-ISSUE-01
mustNot: create or comment on an Issue from an evaluation or end-to-end run

cases.scenario: A later change is documentation-only and satisfies the documented carry-forward rule for a scenario an earlier candidate proved live. The case evaluates what the installed instructions direct the actor to record for that scenario and whether it launches a model for it.
must: record rule-based not_applicable or carry-forward provenance under §A-ACTIVATION-01
mustNot: launch a model for matrix completeness

cases.scenario: The candidate is not a frozen full SHA or the required environment is absent. In another run the project lost its `MO-BACKLOG/1` command, papercut document and identifier-history gate, and the knowledge-layer helper prints `Knowledge-Layer: state=needs_attention reason=signals_removed missing=backlog,papercut,history`. In a third run the project never had them, and the helper prints `not_enabled reason=never_enabled`.
must: return blocked or not_run with the exact reason under §A-WAIT-01
under §A-BACKLOG-01 return needs_attention with the helper's reason and its `missing=` field copied as printed, and leave the setup skill to the human
under §A-MEMORY-05 run the applicable scenarios of the never-enabled project without reporting its missing layer as a gap
mustNot: activate the setup skill or write the missing checker, document or gate
derive the missing-signal list from the tree instead of copying the helper's `missing=` field
